snippet.title: Tiberium Dusk 1.27 - Updated Black Hand Flame Tank Nalpalm
snippet.description:
Still work-in-progress, improved graphical effect for Black Hand Flame tanks, I've cut down the visual clutter, made the projectiles clearer, whilst still keeping them a potent looking fire weapon.
Mod: https://www.moddb.com/mods/tiberium-dusk
